steps.name: Wait for Q / K / V

steps.name: Attention
steps.description: Score Q·K, normalize the scores, combine values, and publish attention output. Open for channel-pass observations.

steps.name: Wait for attention output
steps.description: Wait for the mixer output before the output projection.

steps.name: Q projection
steps.description: Q-owner projection window; includes the region prelude. Not a separate timing for K or V.

steps.name: Q norm + RoPE tail
steps.description: Normalize and rotate the projected Q, then publish it. This outer span is measured once.

steps.name: Raw Q gather
steps.description: Read back raw Q staging. On a two-pass head, P1/P2 retain the last visit: these inner spans are observations, NOT an additive decomposition.

steps.name: Q RMSNorm
steps.description: Sumsq, mean, reciprocal square root, scale and gamma. Two-pass heads retain the last visit.

steps.name: Norm stage + barrier

steps.name: RoPE + Q store
steps.description: Read staging, gather sine/cosine, rotate Q, store and synchronize.

steps.name: Score entry / final-tile arrival

steps.name: Warp skew + stash barrier
steps.description: Other warps' arrival skew plus the stash barrier. This is not pure barrier overhead.

steps.name: Attend atom
steps.description: Max scan, probability/value product, probability sum and finalize gather share this measured span.

steps.name: Tile combine

steps.name: Channel finalize
steps.description: Finalize this channel pass and store the attention output.

steps.name: Output projection

steps.name: Wait for output partials

steps.name: Q projection

steps.name: Raw Q gather

captures.coverage: The recorded layer interior only. Embedding, first input norm, final norm, logits and sampling are not individually timed by these stamps. Layer-to-layer gaps remain unassigned.
captures.semantics: Every stamp is thread 0 reaching a point, not a whole-block completion. Program-order edges are not a complete data-dependency DAG. Two-pass Q-tail inner stamps are last-visit observations; do not sum them as independent operations. Attention S1-S4 retain the final tile: earlier tiles belong to the entry interval, not the individual final-tile operations.

captures.coverage: The recorded layer interior only. Embedding, first input norm, final norm, logits and sampling are not individually timed by these stamps. Layer-to-layer gaps remain unassigned.
captures.semantics: Every stamp is thread 0 reaching a point, not a whole-block completion. Program-order edges are not a complete data-dependency DAG. Two-pass Q-tail inner stamps are last-visit observations; do not sum them as independent operations. Attention S1-S4 retain the final tile: earlier tiles belong to the entry interval, not the individual final-tile operations.
